findings: The analyzer requires a completed 17-slot campaign and matching protocol rescore, then reconstructs TRAIN rows only.
Current campaign reader/window/model code must match the frozen campaign code hash before TRAIN values are read.
Random EMA/shared encoder, predictor and teacher weights must match their seeded initialization bit-for-bit; only the supervised head may have changed.
Checkpoint family, seed, endpoint, source, protocol and TRAIN-only scaler are verified.
Random and true-pretraining diagnostics use the exact same row IDs and cutoff interval IDs.

The corrected implementation binds EMA to ema_sigreg_weight and shared-SIGReg to shared_sigreg_weight; the focused test now executes both control modes and would reproduce the prior shared-key failure.
